title: Haryana Environment, Wildlife and Protected Areas: Quiz

questions.question: Which animal is the state animal of Haryana?
questions.rationale: The blackbuck is the state animal. Chinkara is bred at Kairu in Bhiwani but is not the state symbol.

questions.question: The state bird of Haryana is:
questions.rationale: Black francolin (kala teetar). The peacock is India's national bird.

questions.question: Kalesar National Park is located in which district?
questions.rationale: Kalesar is in Yamunanagar, in the Shivalik foothills adjoining Rajaji and Simbalbara.

questions.question: Sultanpur National Park was upgraded from bird sanctuary to national park in:
questions.rationale: It became a bird sanctuary in 1972 and a national park in 1991. 2003 is Kalesar's national-park year.

questions.question: Which pair of Haryana's Ramsar sites was designated on 25 May 2021?
questions.rationale: Sultanpur National Park and Bhindawas Wildlife Sanctuary are the two Ramsar sites.

questions.question: Which sanctuary is located in Sirsa district?
questions.rationale: Abubshahar in Sirsa is the largest sanctuary by area. Nahar is in Rewari, Khaparwas in Jhajjar and Chhilchhila in Kurukshetra.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT located in Jhajjar district?
questions.rationale: Bir Shikargah is in Panchkula; Bhindawas and Khaparwas are the two Jhajjar sanctuaries.

questions.question: Which statement about the Kalesar area is correct?
options: Its sanctuary was notified in 1996 and the national park in 2003
It is in the Aravalli range
The national park came before the sanctuary
questions.rationale: The sanctuary (1996) preceded the national park (2003). Kalesar is Shivalik, not Aravalli, and is not a Ramsar site.

questions.question: Chhilchhila Wildlife Sanctuary, the smallest in the official list, lies in:
questions.rationale: Chhilchhila is in Kurukshetra district at about 29 ha. Abubshahar is the largest.

questions.question: Which of these is a conservation reserve rather than a wildlife sanctuary?
questions.rationale: Bir Bara Ban in Jind (2007) is a conservation reserve, along with Saraswati Conservation Reserve.

questions.question: Mangar Bani, a sacred grove on the Aravalli ridge, is in which district?
questions.rationale: Mangar Bani lies near Mangar village in Faridabad district, and is protected mainly by local belief in saint Gudariya Das.

questions.question: The Haryana State Pollution Control Board enforces which pair of laws?
questions.rationale: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974 and Air Act 1981. The Wildlife and Forest Acts are separate laws and the years in the swapped option are reversed.

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes Haryana's forest cover?
options: It is among the lowest of Indian states and below the national average
It is the highest in northern India
It is measured every year by HSPCB
questions.rationale: Cover is very low. It is measured by the Forest Survey of India in the two-yearly ISFR, not by HSPCB.

questions.question: The state tree of Haryana is:
questions.rationale: The Bodhi tree, which is the peepal. Sal grows at Kalesar but is not the state tree.
